crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Approximately circular rufous/chestnut patch on the lateral neck and nape region.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Indistinct; a continuous grey plumage transition without a visible demarcation line.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast transverse black and white barring on the tail feathers (rectrices).
